## Data
```{r}
grad <- read.csv("data/gradschool_admissions.csv")

head(grad)
summary(grad)
```

## Explanatory Plot
```{r}
plot(grad$gre, grad$gpa,
     xlab = "GRE Score",
     ylab = "GPA",
     main = "GRE vs GPA")
```

## Logistic Regression Model
```{r}
model <- glm(admit ~ gre + gpa + rank,
             data = grad,
             family = binomial)
summary(model)
```

## Model Accuracy
```{r}
pred <- ifelse(predict(model, type = "response") > 0.5, 1, 0)
mean(pred == grad$admit)
```

## Conclusion
it looks like not one but all of the factors help to explain the higher probability of admission, while attending lower-ranked school is associated with lower admission.
